description: 국토안전관리원_특수교량 정적 계측 데이터 서비스 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토안전관리원. 정적 계측 데이터 서비스는 10분 주기 및 일 단위로 경사, 온도, 시정 등 다양한 환경 데이터를 제공하는 서비스입니다. 이 서비스는 측정값을 실시간으로 수집하고, 사용자가 요청하는 대로 경사계, 시정계, 온도계, 하중계 등 다양한 계측데이터를 제공합니다. 서비스는 RESTful API를 통해 제공되며... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토안전관리원. Its tags are 정적, 계측데이터, 10분, 한시간, 측정데이터. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
